Product Details: Formula 1 is the world's largest selling range of car care products sold in over 75 countries worldwide. Manufactured in USA, Formula 1 is formulated with Grade 1 Carnauba Wax which is a resin obtained from the leaves of a palm tree called Copernica Cerifera. Brazilian natives often refer to the Carnauba tree as the - Tree of Life, because it is used in so many ways to nourish and support. Pure Carnauba wax has the highest melting point of all natural waxes and is widely accepted as the hardest commercial wax known to man. Pure Carnauba, in its natural state, is harder than concrete. One of its most interesting properties is that it swells and closes its pores when exposed to water. Carnauba wax also has the ability to retain oil and has excellent gloss properties. Most other competing car wax brands do not manufacture the products themselves. They are contract manufactured by some other local companies and these brands just market the products. Unlike them, Formula 1 is a direct manufacturer for all car care products with proven expertise and specialty in car care. Being a 'specialized direct manufacturer' is different from being a 'trading brand'. The advantages of this are - direct quality control, no compromise on product quality, intensive focus on R&D and a better understanding of your core market. Formula 1 Ceramic Car Care Range is the latest cutting edge technology in car care ! It presents the strongest adhesive force and keeps the car protected for several months ! Imparts the highest shine and unparalled protection from UV Rays, pollution and even scratches and swirls !
